articles.title: The Clarity Act won’t lead to adoption without crypto tax reform
articles.snippet: The legislation is being framed as a turning point for U.S. crypto policy, but there’s a major piece of the puzzle being overlooked, argues Singh.

articles.title: Spain joins growing list of countries shutting out Polymarket and Kalshi
articles.snippet: The platforms were blocked for operating without licenses required by Spanish gambling law, citing a lack of safeguards for minors and self-excluded gamblers.

articles.title: Hyperliquid takes a swing at Polymarket with macro outcome bets
articles.snippet: The decentralized exchange’s new HIP-4 product lets traders bet on offchain events like inflation and interest-rate decisions, using validators rather than UMA-style external dispute resolution.

articles.title: Spanish authorities block Polymarket and Kalshi over gambling laws
articles.snippet: Spain joined a growing list of national authorities restricting or banning prediction market platforms amid concerns over unlicensed gambling activities.

articles.title: Ex-Hodlnaut CEO charged with fraud over Terra exposure claims
articles.snippet: Singapore police charge ex-Hodlnaut CEO Zhu Juntao with six counts of fraud by false representation over allegedly misleading statements on the company’s exposure to the Terra/UST crash.
